leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: One Lone Pikachu is the ninth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the 13th and 14th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
plainText:
Magical Pokémon Journey: One Lone Pikachu is the ninth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the 13th and 14th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
DO AS I DO, NOT AS I SAY

Meet a young ninja who wants to be like gym leader Koga. He's learning martial arts from his ditto master...who better to teach camouflage and hiding? 

Then, Pikachu tries to pick a flower for Hazel, only to find that everyone in the Pokemon world seems to be gone!

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
The Wal Comes Tumbling Down
Forever Friends ♥

==Important events==
Walnut and Master Ditto appear for the first time.
The group celebrate the one year anniversary of Hazel's and 's first meeting.
